failed.title: Could not read data from Falcon
failed.body: The last read failed. Ask your TENIX SOC to check the Falcon connection.
failed.bodyOld: The last read from Falcon failed. The numbers shown are OLD data from the last complete update: {time}. Ask your TENIX SOC to check the Falcon connection.
failed.bodyNone: The last read from Falcon failed and no complete data was ever stored, so there are no numbers to show. Ask your TENIX SOC to check the Falcon connection.

partial.body: Only part of the findings were read, so the numbers may be lower than the real figures. Last complete update: {time}.

not_synced.title: No data yet
not_synced.body: Data has not been read from Falcon yet. It appears after the first read.
not_synced.bodySoc: Data has not been read from Falcon yet. It appears after the first read.

no_connection.title: No Falcon connection
no_connection.body: This organization has no working Falcon connection yet, so no data is read. Ask your TENIX SOC.
no_connection.bodySoc: This organization has no CrowdStrike login of its own, so the system does not read its data. Any numbers shown are old data.

no_cids.body: This organization has no Falcon connection yet, so no data is loaded. Ask your TENIX SOC administrator.
no_cids.bodySoc: No CrowdStrike connection yet, no data loaded. Add the organization's own API client, CID and cloud in its CrowdStrike section.

states.coverage: Detail kept for {held} of {total} findings in Falcon.
states.priorityPending: The fix-first findings are not all read yet ({held} of {total}).
states.exactCounts: The overview totals come from Falcon's exact counts, not from the rows held here.

reason.invalid_credentials: Reason: wrong Client ID or Client Secret.
reason.cid_not_authorized: Reason: this API client cannot read this CID (it belongs to another CrowdStrike tenant).
reason.missing_scope: Reason: the API client lacks a Spotlight, Discover or Exposure Management read scope.
reason.unreachable: Reason: Falcon could not be reached.
reason.error: Reason: Falcon returned an unexpected error.

chips.csUnconnected: {count, plural, one {# CID} other {# CIDs}} without login

errors.exists: An organization with this name already exists.
errors.name_exists: An organization with this name already exists.
errors.cid_has_connection: This CID already has a connection.
errors.chat_taken: A room can belong to only one organization, in every role.

test.invalid_credentials: Wrong Client ID or Client Secret (or the wrong cloud). Check both and try again.
test.cid_not_authorized: Login works, but this API client cannot read this CID: the CID belongs to another CrowdStrike tenant. Use the API client created in that tenant's own Falcon.
test.missing_scope: Login works, but the API client lacks a scope. Give it read access to Spotlight Vulnerabilities (Spotlight: Read), Discover (Assets: Read) and Exposure Management (External Assets: Read).
test.unreachable: Could not reach CrowdStrike. Check the cloud address and the network.
test.error: CrowdStrike returned an unexpected error. Try again later.

status.failedOld: The last read failed. The numbers shown are OLD data from the last complete update: {time}.
status.failedNone: The last read failed and nothing complete was ever stored.
status.partial: Only part of the data was read; numbers may be lower than real. Last complete update: {time}.
status.no_connection: No login of its own: the system does not read this. Any numbers are old data.
status.no_cids: No CrowdStrike connection yet, no data loaded.

banner.no_cids: No CrowdStrike connection yet, no data loaded. Fill in the CrowdStrike section: Client ID, Client Secret, cloud and CID.
banner.no_connection: This organization's CIDs have no login of their own, so no data is read and what is shown is old. Add each one's own login in the CrowdStrike section.

falcon.help: Each connection is one Falcon API client (Client ID and Secret, cloud) reading one CID. Fill them in for this organization; they are checked against Falcon when you save.
falcon.checkOnSave: Saving checks the login and the CID with Falcon first; nothing is saved if Falcon refuses it. "Test connection" does the same check without saving.
falcon.addedLater: Saved. It will be read in the next round (another sync is running now).
falcon.unconnectedTitle: No login of its own yet
falcon.unconnectedHelp: The system does not read these CIDs and what is shown for them is old data. Add the API client of each CID's own Falcon.
falcon.convertHelp: Checks each CID with the old shared login and keeps it only where Falcon allows it.
falcon.convertFail: The old login cannot read this CID.
falcon.convertedSome: {count, plural, one {# CID} other {# CIDs}} now have their own connection.

falcon.help: Step 2 of 3. This organization's Falcon API client (Client ID, Secret, cloud) and the CID to read. Saving checks them with Falcon.

line.help: Step 3 of 3. News sources and notification groups are two separate lists, each saved on its own.

line.title: LINE
line.help: News sources and notification groups are two separate lists, each saved on its own.

sources.title: News sources (several rooms)
sources.help: LINE rooms that send news to the bot (checked against this organization's devices only).
sources.both: A room here is also a notification group: the bot would answer there twice.

destinations.title: Notification groups (several groups)
destinations.help: LINE groups where the bot sends CVE results for this organization.
destinations.both: A group here is also a news source: the bot would answer there twice.

line.pending: A room ID is typed but not added yet: Save adds it.
line.finishBlocked: Save or clear the changes above first.
